title: First Past the Post means millions of our votes make no difference to parliament. Add your name now to demand a fairer voting system
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
First Past the Post means millions of our votes make no difference to parliament. Add your name now to demand a fairer voting system

It only takes 30 seconds

Actual Article Body:
No party has won a majority of the vote in almost a century, yet due to the voting system we have near-constant single party governments setting the rules for everyone. Our parliaments never represent the views of the public.

Read More

Millions of people can support one party and get a single MP, while a few hundred thousand people who support a different party can get ten times as many. It's no wonder it doesn't feel like we are in charge.

If you agree that we need a voting system where every vote counts, then add your name now >>

“Seats in parliament should match how we vote”
